cards.gloss_en: Dear Ladies, on special offer today are melons, English walnuts, and avocados.

cards.gloss_en: Is there really no picture of this honored and long-serving lady, so that a stock photo has to be used.

cards.gloss_en: And that is exactly why I usually use the masculine and the feminine form, that is "Dear Ladies and Gentlemen".
cards.sentence_de: Und genau deswegen verwende ich meistens die männliche und die weibliche Form, also „Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren“.

cards.gloss_en: Please therefore address your cover letter to "Dear Ladies and Gentlemen".
cards.sentence_de: Bitte richten Sie Ihr Anschreiben daher an „Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren“.
